summary.intent: Confirm the restarted server is running the new code so the user can try the app and a voice call, then restore the voice call option in the UI, which had disappeared after a layout change.
summary.outcome: Confirmed the server runs the new code (restarted at 00:42) and explained how to run a real call. Modified web/src/App.tsx so already-handled cards can be opened and show the card view with the voice button, then built the web app. The call itself was not started and the UI fix was not verified in a browser.

repo: ASK_CALL_PROVIDER=dry_run in .env makes the app's escalation loop only simulate calls; a real call needs ASK_CALL_PROVIDER=openai.

A real call can be triggered directly via `uv run ask-soony alert raise --severity ... --impact ... --title ... --message ... --action ...`; the phone rings from a US number, GPT-Realtime speaks, and the decision returns through the webhook on the server. Cost is about $0.38 per minute.
The UI layout was redesigned by Akshat; the card view containing the voice button is still present but only renders for an open card.
Cards that have been decided/handled are filtered out of the open list, so the voice button became unreachable once all cards were decided.

code.finding: The open/handled card computation and pickCard logic determine whether the detail/card view (with the voice call button) renders; handled cards were not selectable, so the fix makes them openable. Exact line numbers were not shown in the transcript.

workflow: Before saying the app is ready, confirm the running server's code and restart time rather than assuming.
Offer to run costly actions (real phone calls at ~$0.38/min) only after asking the user for confirmation.

friction: The voice call button disappeared from the UI after the layout change, so the user could not start a call from the app.
The app's call flow is simulated by default (dry_run), so testing a real call requires a separate CLI invocation with an env override.
open_items: Verify in the browser that handled cards now open and show the voice call button after the build.
User has not yet approved starting the real phone call test via the CLI.
Consider whether the voice option should be available for handled cards by design or whether the layout should change, since the fix is a workaround for the open-only filter.
